subject.title: fix(ci): keep markdown-only PR jobs off Blacksmith

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this early hosted `ci_scope` gate after rebase, or prefer a different Markdown-only PR CI routing strategy?
rationale: The patch appears technically sound, but workflow runner routing is an automation policy surface where maintainers own the balance between required coverage and Blacksmith registration pressure.

options.title: Adopt hosted scope gate after rebase
options.body: Resolve current-main conflicts, keep docs and security checks present, and land once exact-head CI/proof confirms Markdown-only PR jobs stay on `ubuntu-24.04`.

options.title: Prefer trigger-level filtering
options.body: Close or replace this PR if maintainers want `pull_request.paths-ignore` plus separate docs workflow routing instead of a new scope-gate job.

options.title: Defer CI routing change
options.body: Leave the linked issue open and do not change required CI routing until Blacksmith pressure or required-check policy is revisited.

recommendation.title: Adopt hosted scope gate after rebase
recommendation.body: Resolve current-main conflicts, keep docs and security checks present, and land once exact-head CI/proof confirms Markdown-only PR jobs stay on `ubuntu-24.04`.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the listed project maintainer and has recent adjacent CI reliability history on the touched workflow/docs surface.
